cases.input: Hi, I need a copy of the invoice for my September subscription payment. Please send it to the billing email already saved on my account.
cases.reference_summary: The customer requests the September subscription invoice at their saved billing email address.
required_facts: Requests the September subscription invoice
Wants it sent to the saved billing email address
cases.notes: The requested action concerns an invoice, so this belongs to billing even though an account email address is mentioned.

cases.input: The app froze while I was upgrading my plan, so I tried again. I now see two charges of RM49 in my banking app. Please check whether I paid twice and refund any duplicate. The freezing was annoying, but sorting out the payment is what I need help with first.
cases.reference_summary: The customer reports two RM49 charges after retrying a plan upgrade and requests payment verification and a refund of any duplicate.
required_facts: Reports two charges of RM49
Retried a plan upgrade after the app froze
Requests verification and a refund if there is a duplicate payment
cases.notes: The customer explicitly prioritizes the payment issue over the app freeze. Do not claim the freeze caused a duplicate payment or that a refund has been approved.

cases.input: Saya dah cancel minggu lepas but today kena charge RM29 lagi. Can you check why and refund if this charge shouldn't be there?
cases.reference_summary: The customer says they cancelled last week but were charged RM29 today and requests an explanation and a refund if the charge is incorrect.
required_facts: Says they cancelled last week
Reports a new RM29 charge today
Requests an explanation and a conditional refund
cases.notes: The email mixes Malay and English. The primary request concerns a charge, and the summary must remain in English without assuming the charge is invalid.

cases.input: One of our administrators has left the company. Please explain how I can remove their access without deleting the reports they created.
cases.reference_summary: The customer requests instructions for removing a former administrator's access while preserving their reports.
required_facts: Wants to remove a former administrator's access
Wants to preserve the reports they created
cases.notes: This label assumes the specification explicitly includes team access and administrator management under account. The customer requests instructions, not immediate deletion.

cases.input: Our dashboard has been slow since yesterday, and I also can't sign in after replacing my phone. Please help me recover access first because I no longer have the authenticator app. We can deal with the dashboard speed later.
cases.reference_summary: The customer prioritizes recovering account access after replacing their phone and losing access to their authenticator app.
required_facts: Cannot sign in after replacing their phone
No longer has access to the authenticator app
Prioritizes recovering account access
cases.notes: The customer explicitly prioritizes account recovery over dashboard performance. The summary may omit the secondary performance complaint.

cases.input: cant get in. reset pw twice but no reset email in inbox or spam. same email ive always used. pls help
cases.reference_summary: The customer cannot sign in and has not received a password-reset email after two attempts, including in their spam folder.
required_facts: Cannot sign in
Made two password-reset attempts
No reset email was found in the inbox or spam folder
cases.notes: Interpret 'reset pw twice' in the context of the missing reset emails as two reset attempts; do not claim the password was successfully changed.

cases.input: Since this morning, clicking Export CSV on the reports page downloads a file with only the column headers. The report on screen contains 250 rows. Please help me export the complete report.
cases.reference_summary: The customer reports that CSV exports contain only headers despite 250 visible report rows and requests a complete export.
required_facts: CSV export contains only column headers
The on-screen report contains 250 rows
Wants the complete report exported
cases.notes: A product function produces an incomplete result. Do not claim the underlying report data has been deleted.

cases.input: I paid for the Pro plan yesterday, but the PDF export button now gives an error every time I click it. I'm not asking for a refund or a different plan. Please help me get the PDF export working for my presentation tomorrow.
cases.reference_summary: The customer requests help fixing PDF export errors before a presentation tomorrow and explicitly does not request a refund or plan change.
required_facts: PDF export fails with an error
Wants the export function fixed
Needs it for a presentation tomorrow
cases.notes: Payment and refund words are distracting context. The explicit requested action is to repair the export functionality.

cases.input: Is your service down or is this just our setup? Webhook deliveries have failed for about 20 minutes, but the dashboard still loads. Can you investigate? We haven't identified the cause.
cases.reference_summary: The customer requests investigation of webhook delivery failures lasting about 20 minutes while the dashboard remains accessible and the cause is unknown.
required_facts: Webhook deliveries have failed for about 20 minutes
The dashboard still loads
Requests investigation without a confirmed cause
cases.notes: Do not turn the customer's outage question into a confirmed service outage or blame their setup. This case tests preservation of uncertainty.

cases.input: Will your customer training webinar next Tuesday be recorded? I can't attend live and would like to watch it afterward.
cases.reference_summary: The customer asks whether next Tuesday's training webinar will be recorded so they can watch it afterward.
required_facts: Asks whether next Tuesday's training webinar will be recorded
Wants to watch afterward because they cannot attend live
cases.notes: This is an informational request outside billing, account administration, and broken functionality. Do not promise that a recording will be available.

cases.input: Please tell me whether you run live training sessions for new customers. Also, please send me last month's invoice. Both requests are equally important to me.
cases.reference_summary: The customer asks about live training for new customers and requests last month's invoice, giving both requests equal priority.
required_facts: Asks whether live training is available for new customers
Requests last month's invoice
Explicitly gives both requests equal priority
cases.notes: Apply the documented tie-breaker: when no primary request is clear, select the first explicit request. Training information appears before the invoice request, so the category is general.

cases.input: Love having to do the same clicks fifty times. Everything works, before you ask. Any chance you'll add a bulk-rename option for folders? That's a feature request, not a bug report.
cases.reference_summary: The customer requests a bulk-rename feature for folders and clarifies that the existing functionality works.
required_facts: Requests a bulk-rename option for folders
Says the existing functionality works
Describes the request as a feature suggestion rather than a bug
cases.notes: Sarcastic dissatisfaction does not establish broken functionality. Under the current policy, feature suggestions belong to general.
